verdict.rationale: Undermind ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.undermind.ai/mcp) with documented setup for Cursor, VS Code, and Claude, explicitly stating it works with any MCP-compatible client, plus a rich set of MCP tools (literature review, PDF Q&A, notes, curation). This is well-documented first-party evidence though lacking independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP integration specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community verification that the MCP server works reliably in practice, and broader third-party client compatibility testing beyond the vendor's own examples.
